item.title: Maven Project Directory Management
item.description: Recently I’ve been trying to write projects with Maven, but unfortunately my skills aren’t good enough. I got stuck at the beginning by the Maven project directory arrangement. Let me first introduce the situation. My project will be divided into several modules. It’s roughly like this: - project - module 1 - module 2 - module 3 And after thinking about it carefully, this problem can actually be divided into several small problems:
